deadline.value: December 15 for September (Fall) admission, international and domestic. Year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: For September admission the deadline is December 15th.

gre_subject.value: Not required; encouraged (General and Subject); ask your potential supervisor
gre_subject.quote: GRE is not required. However, applicants are encouraged to take the GRE (General and Subject) and provide the results

supervisor.value: Not required, but highly recommended: professors select students for their groups
supervisor.quote: It's not a requirement to get in touch with potential supervisors ahead of time, but it's highly recommended that you do. In our department, individual professors select students to join their research groups.

funding.value: All graduate students receive a standard stipend, plus possible TA work
funding.quote: Our graduate students all receive a standard stipend, and in addition you can be hired as a teaching assistant

entry_route.value: PhD applicants should be completing or have completed an MSc; BSc holders apply to the MSc
entry_route.quote: or have completed an M.Sc. degree can apply to our Ph.D. program. Students who are completing or have completed a B.Sc. degree should apply to our M.Sc. program.

gre_general.value: Not required, but encouraged because many supervisors use it
gre_general.quote: GRE is not required. However, applicants are encouraged to take the GRE (General and Subject) and provide the results, as many supervisors make use of this information in selecting students.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 86 with no component below 20; IELTS 6.5 overall
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 86 for the internet based test with each component not less than 20. For the IELTS exam, with a minimum overall band score of 6.5 is required.

ielts_min.quote: For the IELTS exam, with a minimum overall band score of 6.5 is required.

notes: The department FAQ answers 'Do I need to speak French?'; read it before applying. A Winter (January) intake also exists.
